title: Meet The "Coco House"-The Chicago Home That Became A Viral Sensation For Its Spectacular Decorations - NewsBreak
text:
By Tori Levy ,
1 days ago Coco is a lovely film that addresses the themes of death and loss while highlighting the importance of familial responsibility and the act of remembering loved ones who have passed away. What resonates deeply with many viewers is the idea that people continue to exist as long as they are remembered by those who are still living. The animation is uniformly beautiful , celebrating Día de Muertos, to such an extent that you want to capture every moment before it’s over. And now, you can soak in the vibrant movie in real life —at the Coco-themed house with delightful Halloween decor inspired by everything from the film. Where is the Coco-themed house near Chicago? Address: 7735 W Gregory St., Chicago, IL 60656 The house beautifully reflects all aspects of the movie , from the characters to the ofrenda.
